title: Umuvugizi w'inzahabu mu bugaragwa
intro: Iyumvire ikambi nini yo mu bugaragwa mu kanya k’ugutegerezwa n’ukudakeka. Umurongozi akomeye yaragiye guhura n’Ubumana, asiga inyuma umuryango wipfuza cane ikintu gifatika co gufatako. Muri ako karuhuko katagira aho gahera, umuntu yemeza aratera imbere afise amasezerano akayangane be n’ikiremwa c’ubwenge kimeze nk’ikizima.
clues: Nari mu bavuye mu Misiri bari kumwe na Musa, mbona ikiyaga cagabanutse kugira ngo turokoke.
Naravye igihe umurongozi wacu yaja ku musozi amajoro mirongo ine kugira ngo aronke ubuyobozi.
Narakorakoranya ibisharizo mu bantu, ndabibumbabumba n’amaboko yanje bwite.
Naciye nkora inyana itanga ijwi ry’uguboroga, maze ndayihamagara abantu.
Nafashe urushinge rw’umukungugu mu nzira y’intumwa, ndaruterera mu vyo nakoze.
Narahanganye na Musa ndacirwa urubanza rwo kuvuga ngo ‘ntunkoreko’ no kubana n’abandi, n’ikoraniro ryasezeranywe ry’urubanza.

trial.label: Igerageza/Ivyabaye
options: Yasavye gusengwa nk’umukama mukuru kuruta abandi bose muri Egiputa .
Yarubatse ubwato kugira ngo barokoke umwuzure mwinshi .
Yategetse umuriro munini wo guturira Ibrahimu .

arabic: قَالَ فَٱذْهَبْ فَإِنَّ لَكَ فِى ٱلْحَيَوٰةِ أَن تَقُولَ لَا مِسَاسَ ۖ وَإِنَّ لَكَ مَوْعِدًۭا لَّن تُخْلَفَهُۥ ۖ وَٱنظُرْ إِلَىٰٓ إِلَـٰهِكَ ٱلَّذِى ظَلْتَ عَلَيْهِ عَاكِفًۭا ۖ لَّنُحَرِّقَنَّهُۥ ثُمَّ لَنَنسِفَنَّهُۥ فِى ٱلْيَمِّ نَسْفًا
verse: [Moses] said, "Then go. And indeed, it is [decreed] for you in [this] life to say, 'No contact.' And indeed, you have an appointment [in the Hereafter] you will not fail to keep. And look at your 'god' to which you remained devoted. We will surely burn it and blow it [i.e., its ashes] into the sea with a blast. (20:97)
